messages:
maya: Quick one We're promoting Zoe IC -> Manager effective 2026-04-05. Need cutoffs for getting salary effective that run, backpay timing, bonus proration for Q2, and if RSU grant can use 4/5 as grant date.
liam: Payroll cutoff for April mid-month run is 2026-04-07 COB. If HR change is entered before that it hits the run; otherwise we need off-cycle. Off-cycle requests take ~3 business days.
zoe: Prefer single lump-sum backpay. Any docs I should sign?
liam: Yes: signed Comp Change Request + manager approval email + GL code. Backpay is a lump-sum labeled "Promotion Backpay" and calculated by prorating days in pay period.
maya: Bonus proration?
liam: Prorate target by days under each role in quarter. Existing earned commissions remain unchanged.
hr-bot: Note: manager grants require comp committee approval. If committee signs off after 4/5, grant date will be actual approval date; paperwork can request retroactive grant date but it's subject to rules.
payroll: Attach signed form and manager approval to payroll@redwood.com. Use GL prefix HR-OP-###. We'll confirm off-cycle window once packet arrives.
maya: Action: I'll send signed form + packet by 2026-04-06 COB to hit mid-month run. Thanks! :thumbsup:
